name: Ghost Face (Su)
body:
Benefit(s): A ninja with this trick can use her ki to assume a horrific, inhuman face and posture. She may roll two dice while making an Intimidate check and take the better result. A ninja must choose to use this trick before making an Intimidate check. Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point.

Ultimate Options: Power of the Ninja © 2011, Rogue Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
